translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SANTIAGO
book.title: An u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic c’al a Santiago

content: A Santiago in thuchanchal an u in at juntalchic axi pil u c’uajil
Nana’ in Santiago tin t’ojnalil a Dios ani i Ajatic Jesucristo tu tsapnethal ax it lajuj tsab cuenel Israel buc’uc’ul c’uajil tim puhuel an tsabal.
A Dios tu pithalchic i tsalpathtalab
Ebchalabchic, in tomnal quit lej culbe tam quit tacchiquiyat c’al jant’oquitsq’ui.
Cum a tso’obits abal a Dios ti tacchiquiyal abal ti tsu’u max a lej chubax belal. Max it tacchiquiyab ani a junini’ belale, ne’ets ca puhuey a cuxuthtal.
Ca jum putat puhuey a cuxuthtal abal yabats ca más q’uibchi, ani tam ojni’ ne’ets ca tala’ cuxuy jahuaquitsq’ui tam tacchiquixtalab.
Max a q’uibchalchic an tsalpathtalab ca conchi a Dios abal ti pitha’, cum pelits in ey lej pithoblix. Ne’ets ti pitha’ ani yab ne’ets ti c’uiya’.
Expith ca junini’ bela’ ta ichich abal chubax ne’ets ti pitha’, cum max a ne’thal a ichich c’al i hualamtalab c’al a Dios ejtil i ja’ axi lanq’uiq’uil ani ne’thathal ju’tamits ta ca juchun an ic’.
Max antsana’ a ichich, yab jant’o ne’ets quit pithan c’al an Ajatic.
Axi jalc’u’ in ichich yab in ejtohual quin co’oy t’ayat mo’cathits in ichich c’al a Dios.
Ca culbe an ts’ejhuantal ebchalab cum c’athpich in ey c’al a Dios.
Ca culbe jaye an rico ebchalab aba ani’ yab jant’o in ey in ricotal c’al a Dios. Cum an rico jaye ejtil in huitsil i ts’ojol, yab u ohuel.
Tam ca calejits an thijiy c’ac’al, u bachc’unalits an ts’ojol ani u ijcanalits in huitsil. Yabats alabel. Antsana’ ne’ets ca thubat taley an rico biyat u lej t’ojlinal.
An yajchictalab ani an nixoc’naxtalab c’al an hualabtalab

Ne’ets cu culbe max qui cuxuy cu tacchiquiyat c’al i cuxuth ichich. Max antsana’ tu tsu’chal a Dios i ichich, ne’ets tucu pitha’ i atabilab tihua’ ti eb jant’ini’ ti bijchithits axi c’anithom c’al jaja’.
Max cu nixoc’na abal cu hualbin, yab qui ulu max ja’its a Dios ax tu nixoc’nal. Yab ja, cum a Dios yab pel i nixoc’nax c’al an hualabtalab ani yab u nixoc’nab ca hualbin.
Ja’its i cuete’ hualbith le’nomtal ax tu nixoc’nal ani tu c’ambiyal abal cu hualbin.
C’al i hualbith le’nomtal jats tu tujel an hualabtalab, ani c’al tin ebal an hualabtalab jats tu tsemel huahua’.
Ichich hual ebchalabchic, yab quit c’ambiyat c’al i q’uibts’oth tsalap.

Ca tequeth tso’obna’ abal ja’its a Dios ti eb ax tu pithal patal i alhua’talab axi lej huinat alhua’ ani quithat. Ja’its jaja’ ax in ts’ejca’ a q’uicha ani a otchic ani patal jahuats im binal in tajax ti eb. Max u jalc’unal in tsap in tajax jaja’chic, a Dios iba cum ni hue’ yab u jalc’unal in ey. Ets’ey tu pithal expith jahua’ alhua’.
Cum pelits in le’nomtal tu pithamalits i it ejattalab c’al in cahuintal axi lej chubaxtalab t’aychith ti ichich, ani xo’ pel tu oc’ox huenc’onelom c’al a Dios.
Jahua’ in t’ajal jita’ chubax c’ac’nax c’al a Dios

Ichich hual ebchalabchic, cum it it ejatlithits ca lej canat bina’ a xutsun c’al in cahuintal a Dios. Ca lej alhua’ tsalapnanchi ani ca c’aya’ olnaxnanchi an inicchic. C’al a ichich c’aya’ yab quit thubat tsacuy.
Cum yab u culbel a Dios c’al in tsacultal an inic.

Expith ca t’ajat jila’ patal jahua’ yab t’ocat ani patal jahua’ quithab lej yan hua’ats teje’ ti al an hualab c’ay’lal, ani c’al i tsa’attalab ca jila’ a Dios ti t’aychi ta ichich in cahuintal ax in lej cua’al in tsap abal ti jec’ontha’.
Ca chubax t’aja’ jahua’ in ulal in cahuintal a Dios ani yab expith ca ats’anchiq’ui, cum max expith a ats’anchalq’ui tocat a c’ambiyal a cuete’ ichich.
Jitats quin ats’anchiq’ui expith ani yab quin chubax t’aja’ jahua’ in ulal in cahuintal a Dios, pel ejtil i inic axi tocat quin met’a’ in hual al i lam ani alhua’its.
Tocat in met’alq’ui ani in thubat uc’chiyal jant’ini’ tin tsu’u in hual.

Jitats yab quin uc’chiy ani quin junini’ t’aja’ jahua’ in ulal in tequeth cahuintal a Dios c’al tu hualcanthab an inic, jats axi ne’ets ca c’uajiy culbel c’al a Dios ani c’al patal jahua’ quin t’aja’.
Hualam max i tsalpayal abal u lej c’ac’nax c’al a Dios. Yab chubax ani’ max yab i hui’nal i cau axi alhua’, tocat i c’ambiyal i cuete’ ichich ani jolat i c’ac’naxtal.

Max chubax i c’ac’nal a Dios ne’ets qui tolmiy axi oth inicchic ani axi pel i tsemchith uxumchic c’al i yejenchixtalab jahua’ in cua’al. Ne’ets qui alhua’ beletna’ i ichich abal yab ca quithabme c’al jahua’ hua’ats quithab teje’ tsabal. Ja’its an lej c’ac’naxtalab axi c’al u culbel i Tata Dios.
